processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Binary Fe-Al alloys were prepared by vacuum induction melting in Al2O3 crucibles using Fe with 99.99% purity (purified by zone melting) and Al with 99.999% purity.
Solidification in Cu moulds to obtain rods usually with 18 mm diameter; alloys used as-cast (no subsequent heat treatment) and contain no second phases.

processing_steps.method: electrostatic discharge machining, mechanical polishing and ultrasound cleaning in acetone; compression specimens 5x5x10 mm3 with ground surfaces; tensile specimens turned per DIN 50125
processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Specimens were cut by electrostatic discharge machining, mechanically polished and cleansed by ultrasound in acetone. Compression specimens had dimensions 5x5x10 mm3; cylindrical tensile specimens were prepared by turning according to German standard DIN 50125.

structures.overall_structure: Coarse-grained polycrystalline single-phase Fe-Al solid solution; the as-cast alloy contains no second phases.

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Specimens etched by an alcoholic 10% nitric acid solution
characterization_methods.key_findings: Polycrystals showed a coarse grain structure with grain sizes of the order of 1 mm; as-cast alloys contained no second phases.

characterization_methods.technique: scanning electron microscopy (SEM) with energy-dispersive X-ray (EDX) analysis
characterization_methods.purpose: study of fracture surfaces and qualitative precipitate analysis

characterization_methods.key_findings: The real Al content of the nominal 8 at.% Al alloy is 7.9 at.% (4.0 wt.%).

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Room temperature and -100 °C; strain rates 10^-4 s^-1 and 10^-2 s^-1; specimens 5x5x10 mm3, total straining at least 5%
characterization_methods.purpose: determination of yield stress as a function of Al content
characterization_methods.key_findings: Yield stress increases linearly with increasing Al content at both compression rates at room temperature.

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Rates between 10^-4 s^-1 and 10^-2 s^-1; room temperature and -100 °C; cylindrical specimens per DIN 50125
characterization_methods.purpose: study of ductility (strain before necking, fracture strain) as a function of Al content
characterization_methods.key_findings: Ductility decreases with increasing Al content; Fe-8 at.%Al shows a relative maximum in strain before necking and fracture strain at room temperature.

unmapped_findings: The real composition of the nominal Fe-8 at.%Al polycrystalline alloy (Table 1) is 7.9 at.% (4.0 wt.-%) Al, with impurity contents C 50 wt.ppm and Si 80 wt.ppm and no other residual elements listed above the reporting threshold. (b0025)

The yield stress of the as-cast polycrystalline Fe-Al alloys increases linearly with increasing Al content up to 18 at.% at room temperature at both compression rates (10^-2 and 10^-4 s^-1); the interpolating straight lines indicate a yield-stress increase of 21 and 23 MPa per unit% for the higher rate and the lower rate, respectively, with Fe-8%Al lying on this line. (b0032)

The solid-solution hardening coefficient reported for the polycrystalline as-cast alloys (0-18 at.% Al) is about 2.2 GPa, in contrast with about 1 GPa reported for monocrystals; the difference is attributed to differences in alloy preparation (as-cast polycrystals vs annealed monocrystals) and slip mode. (b0058)

At room temperature both the strain before necking and the fracture strain show apparent relative maxima at about 8 and 12 at.% Al, which is less pronounced at -100 °C; therefore Fe-8%Al corresponds to a local ductility maximum. (b0040, b0059)
Deformation twinning was observed at room temperature only for the Fe-18%Al alloy and, at -100 °C, for Al contents in the range 11-18%; it was not reported for Fe-8%Al. (b0032, b0064)

The as-cast polycrystalline Fe-8%Al alloy was tested without any subsequent heat treatment; heat treatments reported in the paper apply only to separately prepared samples (e.g. furnace-cooled, quenched), with the as-cast condition serving as the baseline. (b0022)
